sources.title: Quality Systems Approach to Pharmaceutical Current Good Manufacturing Practice Regulations
sources.scope: FDA landing-page description of a modern quality-systems and risk-management approach consistent with drug CGMP requirements.
supported_claims: Quality-system review and risk management are relevant administrative concepts for pharmaceutical manufacturing records.
Guidance does not replace applicable CGMP requirements.
sources.limitations: It does not prescribe this scenario's checklist, due dates, priorities, schemas, evidence codes, or automated compliance conclusion.

sources.title: Investigating Out-of-Specification Test Results for Pharmaceutical Production
sources.scope: FDA landing-page description of guidance for evaluating test results outside established specifications or acceptance criteria.
supported_claims: Investigation evidence can include evaluation of results outside established specifications.
A structured review packet can preserve investigation evidence for qualified review.
sources.limitations: This scenario does not evaluate laboratory science, determine root cause, invalidate a result, disposition product, or implement the guidance's full content.

sources.title: Data Integrity and Compliance With Drug CGMP: Questions and Answers
sources.scope: FDA landing-page description emphasizing reliable and accurate data and risk-based strategies for managing data-integrity risks.
supported_claims: Quality records used for review should preserve reliable and accurate evidence.
Contradictory source records should remain visible rather than being silently overwritten.
sources.limitations: The source does not define this scenario's duplicate algorithm, exact identifiers, task queue, dates, or evidence sufficiency rules.
